metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Border 2
metas.description: Young Indian fighters prepared to protect their homeland from a greater threat during the 1971 Indo-Pak war.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2026 · Batwara 1947
metas.description: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.
